_notes: DRAFT v2 - matches the actual Excel 'Suggestion' block (columns S/O/D/Prevention, purple header, already present but empty) plus one new 'Remark' column to be added right after Prevention. Every value below is a FLAT SHORT STRING - these are single Excel cells, not nested JSON, so a merged/ambiguous row gets one combined sentence in Detection/Prevention with the split explained in Remark, not separate sub-fields. Occurrence is intentionally left blank - it needs real plant defect-frequency data, not an AI guess.

example_row_single_mode.Detection_D: Add an in-station connector-latch sensor (vision or force-check) confirming both headlamp connectors are fully seated before the operator proceeds.
example_row_single_mode.Prevention: Add a connector-latch verification interlock at this station that stops the line if either connector is not seated/locked.
example_row_single_mode.Remark: Single failure mode, not merged. Severity 10 - explicit accident-risk effect stated (loose connector can leave headlamp non-functional, reducing visibility).

example_row_merged_mode.Detection_D: For scratch: visual/vision-inspection gate before install. For damage: in-line continuity/illumination test at the install station to catch a unit that fails to light.
example_row_merged_mode.Prevention: For scratch: padded, segregated storage-trolley slots to prevent handling damage. For damage: barcode/part-ID scan interlock at pick point to block an incompatible variant from being installed.
example_row_merged_mode.Remark: Merged failure mode: 'Scratch on headlamp' (1st) + 'Damage on headlamp' (2nd). Severity 8 = worst case (damage -> total loss of function); scratch alone would only be S4 (cosmetic). See full JSON's possible_severities for the 7/8 ambiguity breakdown.

example_row_merged_mode_torque.Detection_D: Use a torque-controlled tool with data logging/OK-NOK output at the fastening station to flag out-of-spec torque immediately, plus a periodic torque-check audit.
example_row_merged_mode_torque.Prevention: Use a torque-controlled DC tool with an upper-limit shutoff (not just lower-limit OK/NOK) to prevent over-torquing the housing/lens.
example_row_merged_mode_torque.Remark: Row covers both directions of torque error (under- and over-). For THIS row (over-torque specifically): direct effect is lens cracking, not rattling (rattling is the under-torque row's mechanism) - Detection/Prevention above are written for the over-torque mechanism specifically.
